messages:
elaine: main turned red after a tiny merge. canary-smoke job OOM'd on node-42. CI run: https://ci.redwood/test/10345 — failing step 'smoke-inference'. Anyone owning the canary image or recent infra changes? :eyes:

ci-bot: automated CI alert — build #10345 failed (canary-smoke). logs attached.

raj: taking a look now. grabbing logs from that node. @morgan did you merge anything touching the canary image or docker defaults in the last hour?

morgan: I merged #5823 ~20m ago (kv-cache tweak). didn’t touch model code, but I did change the dockerfile MEM_LIMIT default from 12G -> 14G for local debugging. didn’t think it would hit canary. rolling that back now.

elaine: ok please revert if that’s likely. if it's memory, rerun with a larger machine is fastest to confirm. @dev-oncall can you stand up a 32G canary node and queue a rerun?

dev-oncall: allocating a temporary 32G node on us-west-2 and requeueing job as #10346. ETA ~90s. also will pin the canary image to the previous sha while we triage.

raj: got the logs: OOM during kv-cache warmup, worker killed: 
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:05Z] ERROR: worker 2345 killed by OOM at allocation of 1.2G during kv-cache init
[stack trace trimmed]
```
Looks correlated with the docker MEM_LIMIT bump. good call, morgan.

morgan: revert PR landed at 1777777722. pinged CI re-run. if #10346 passes we can mark as rollout-caused and cut a follow-up to avoid default mem changes on canary.

ci-bot: rerun #10346 started.

(1m) dev-oncall: rerun finished — PASS for canary-smoke. :white_check_mark: #10346.

elaine: ok passing with the larger node/pinned image. seems like the MEM_LIMIT bump made the canary image pack more runtime memory and pushed it over in the constrained canary pool. we should: 1) revert the MEM_LIMIT change (done), 2) add a canary-only resource test that runs in CI, 3) document that default mem changes must go through eng-infra.

raj: agree. i'll open a bisect task only if rerun had failed. since it passed, we can treat this as a config/regression from the docker change. i'll file ENGINFRA-1227 for the follow-ups and add you both as assignees.

morgan: sorry about the noise — will follow the checklist for resource defaults next time. :bow:
